grades.quote: the execution of `RDTIME` instructions at the PLV1/PLV2/PLV3 level can be prohibited, or will trigger the **I** nstruction **P** rivilege error **E** xception (IPE).
grades.reason: The passage names the Instruction Privilege Error Exception (IPE) as the exception raised when an instruction (RDTIME) is executed at a PLV level where it has been disabled via CSR.MISC. This is the right exception for a privilege violation. It only covers the RDTIME case, not privileged instructions in general, so it is a useful part of the answer and not a full one.
